Class NitriteQueryExecutor

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.read.NitriteQueryExecutor
@Internal public final class NitriteQueryExecutor extends Object
Executes runtime data retrieval queries against a Nitrite collection.

This executor consolidates fetching, aggregation, and projection logic:

  • Distinct Counts: Supports COUNT_DISTINCT via implicit $group._id pipelines.
  • Single-Field Projections: Fully supports native single-field projections (e.g. querying a List<String> of names), contrary to stale legacy comments.
  • Aggregations: Resolves derived aggregations (max, min, sum, avg) for numeric and temporal fields (note: sum/avg on dates is intentionally excluded).
Since:
5.2.0

    • executeDelete

      public Optional<Number> executeDelete(@NonNull @NonNull io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.PreparedQuery<?,Number> q, NitritePreparedQuery<?,Number> nq)
      Executes a delete operation based on the provided prepared query. Extracts the pre-compiled Nitrite filter, applies optimistic locking rules if applicable, and performs the removal against the underlying Nitrite collection.
      Parameters:
      q - the generic prepared query containing execution metadata
      nq - the compiled Nitrite prepared query holding the exact filter
      Returns:
      an optional containing the number of deleted records
      Throws:
      io.micronaut.data.exceptions.OptimisticLockException - if optimistic locking is enabled and no records were deleted

    • count

      public long count(NitritePreparedQuery<?,?> nq)
      Executes a count query to determine the number of matching documents. This operation bypasses normal result projection and mapping entirely to efficiently size the query result directly from the Nitrite cursor. It natively supports COUNT_DISTINCT by resolving a nested $group stage if present in the translated JSON string.
      Parameters:
      nq - the compiled Nitrite prepared query holding the exact filter
      Returns:
      the total number of documents matching the query filter
